## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` is clean
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` has been run
- [ ] New behaviour has a test
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the
      [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/)

## Origin of the code

- [ ] This is my own work, or it comes from a GPL-compatible source that I have credited.
- [ ] It contains **no** code, resources or data copied from Internet Download Manager or any
      other proprietary product, and nothing transcribed or translated from decompiled output.
